edit.description: null spawn status (signal-killed engine) exits UNREACHABLE, not 1; stderr names the signal
fake engine that kills itself by signal; skips off linux-x64 like its siblings

summary: Launcher exits 2, not 1, when the engine it spawned is killed by a signal, so a gate hook fails loud instead of open

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

acceptance: A signal-killed engine (spawnSync status null) makes the launcher exit 2 with the signal on stderr; a status the engine returned still passes through
notes: Fail-loud invariant: 'if it cannot check, it fails loud'; for a gate hook loud is exit 2. A signal-killed engine never finished checking, so `result.status ?? 1` fails open under a hook. Its test is an SDK test (sdk/test/launcher.test.ts), held by the SDK gate, so the entry names no tests[] line (PROTOCOL, Tests, question 2).
